newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Azores electricity firm issues 7.5 bln esc bond.
newsitem.headline: Azores electricity firm issues 7.5 bln esc bond.

text.p: EDA Finance Ltd, a special financing vehicle for EDA-Empresa de Electricidade dos Acores, is launching a 10-year, 7.5 billion escudo eurobond with call and put options in the seventh year, indexed to the six-month Lisbor rate plus 35 basis points, bookrunner and joint lead manager Banco Finantia said.
INTEREST Six-month Lisbor plus 35 basis points
PRICE Par LAW English LISTING Lux
JOINT LEADS Banco Finantia and Morgan Stanley
NOTE - The electricity concern is 100 percent owned by the regional government of the Azores Islands.
